description: First disk created with test-sim.sh script to run with dfence
author: Harshil Patel
example_usage:
workload = board.set_kernel_disk_workload(
    kernel=//obtain kernel,
    disk_image=obtain_resource(resource_id="x86-ubuntu-24.04-img"),
    bootloader=//bootloader resource,
)
def exit_event_handler():
    print('first exit event: Kernel booted')
    yield False
    print('second exit event: In after boot')
    yield False
    print('third exit event: After run script')
    yield True

simulator = Simulator(
    board=board,
    on_exit_event={
        ExitEvent.EXIT: exit_event_handler(),
    },
)

description: A full boot of Ubuntu 24.04 with Linux 6.8.0-52-generic for X86. It runs `m5 exit` at specific times in the boot process. Please refer to the README for diskimage for more information. If specified the readfile will be executed after booting.
example_usage:
workload = board.set_workload(obtain_resource(resource_id="x86-ubuntu-24.04-dfence"))
def exit_event_handler():
    print('first exit event: Kernel booted')
    yield False
    print('second exit event: In after boot')
    yield False
    print('third exit event: After run script')
    yield True

simulator = Simulator(
    board=board,
    on_exit_event={
        ExitEvent.EXIT: exit_event_handler(),
    },
)
